messages.author: f5bec70b36df06aa
messages.subject: Remove outliers from box plot
parts:
H@all,

I have a data set, which consists 2 measured parameters (Result1 and
Result2) from two different locations. I would like to use box plots
in ggplot but I would like to remove the outliers from the plot as
they are very high and the actual box plot would show up as a thin box
at the bottom of the plot. I had a look on the internet for a solution
and managed to come up with the following code:

read.csv("http://dl.dropbox.com/u/4236038/outliers_boxplots.csv")-
>flow

p<-ggplot(flow, aes(Location, Result2))

p2<-p+geom_boxplot(width=0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +
opts(legend.key=theme_rect(fill=NULL,colour="white")) +
opts(panel.grid.minor = theme_blank()) + opts(panel.grid.major =
theme_blank()) +xlab("") + scale_y_continuous(~"Result ("*m^3*")") +
opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(colour = 'black', size = 13,vjust=-0.6))
+ opts(axis.title.y = theme_text(colour = 'black', size = 13, angle =
90)) + opts(axis.line = theme_segment(colour = NA))+ opts(axis.ticks =
theme_segment(colour = 'black'))+ opts(panel.background =
theme_rect(colour = 'black'))+ opts(plot.background =
theme_rect(colour=NA)) +opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(colour =
'black', size=12))+ opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(colour = 'black',
size=12)) + geom_text(aes(x2,y2,label = texthere), data.frame(x2=0.55,
y2=0.7, texthere="N=23"))

p2 + coord_cartesian(ylim = quantile(flow$Result2, c(0.1, 0.9),
na.rm=TRUE))

However, there are no axis labels on the y axis and the box plots
start straight at y=0. How can I show the y-axis labels and also put a
bit of space between the x axis and the box plots?

Any help would be highly appreciated.

Thanks for your effort.

Martin

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Remove outliers from box plot
parts:
Hi

I can see the y axis label.
As for the space between x axis and boxes, try:

p2 + coord_cartesian(ylim =
scales::expand_range(quantile(flow$Result2, c(0.1, 0.9), na.rm=TRUE),
0.05))
